parent.consentPilot: Feelio is in a small, invite-only pilot. This consent text is a draft and has not been reviewed by a lawyer yet.
parent.consentIntro: To create a profile for your child, we need your consent. Here is what Feelio stores and why:

consentScopes.child_profile: An age group, a language and an optional nickname (encrypted). No real name, no photo, no email.
consentScopes.progress: Which levels and scenarios your child has finished, so the world unlocks.
consentScopes.usage_limits: How many minutes your child used each feature today, to enforce your limits.
consentScopes.voice_companion: Voice conversations are processed live by our voice provider and are not recorded. Feelio does not keep transcripts.
consentScopes.stories: Stories your child asks for, kept for 90 days or until you delete them.
consentScopes.safety_events: If something worrying is said, a short safety note (not the conversation) for safety review.

parent.consentRights: You can see your child's profile and devices and delete a profile or your whole account at any time. Exporting data and withdrawing consent from the dashboard are coming later in the pilot; until then, contact us.
parent.consentCheckbox: I am the parent or legal guardian, and I give consent for my child to use Feelio as described.
parent.nicknameHint: Only shown to you and your child. Never sent to any AI service.
parent.setUpHint: Open this page on your child's tablet or phone, then press the button. For safety, you will be signed out of the parent area on that device.
parent.deleteChild: Delete this profile and all its data
parent.deleteChildConfirm: This permanently deletes the profile, progress and devices. It can't be undone.
parent.deleteAccount: Delete my account and all data
parent.deleteAccountConfirm: This permanently deletes your account, your children's profiles and all their data.
parent.sensitiveGate: For your child's safety, please confirm your password again first.
parent.talkNote: Voice is in adult testing only for now, until our voice provider approves use by children. Turning this on today only shows the microphone step.
parent.handOver: Last step: give this device to {name}. Open this page on their tablet or phone and press the button below.
parent.hoursNote: Feelio can only be used on these days and between these times, in your time zone ({zone}). You can change the time zone in Account.
parent.hoursError: Choose at least one day, and an end time after the start time.
parent.timezoneNote: Daily limits and allowed hours follow this time zone.
parent.timezoneError: Please choose a time zone from the list.
parent.restingNow: Feelio is resting now: it's outside the allowed hours.
parent.restingUntil: Feelio is resting now (outside the allowed hours). Next available at {time}.
parent.timeUpNow: Today's time is used up. Feelio will be back tomorrow.
parent.weekLimit: The dashed line is the daily limit: {n} minutes.
parent.summariesNone: Nothing to report. Feelio hasn't needed to step in.
parent.summariesNote: These are short notes, never the conversation itself. A few very sensitive situations are handled by our safety team instead.

summary.selfHarm: Your child said something suggesting they might want to hurt themselves. Feelio stayed calm, encouraged them to talk to a trusted grown-up right away and showed where to get help. Please check in with your child gently today.
summary.danger: Your child described what sounded like an emergency. Feelio told them to get a grown-up or call the emergency number.
summary.bullying: Your child mentioned being hurt or bullied by other children. Feelio was supportive and encouraged them to tell a trusted grown-up.
summary.worryOutside: Your child shared something worrying about someone outside your home. Feelio said it wasn't their fault and encouraged them to talk to a trusted grown-up.
summary.onlineSafety: Your child described someone asking for secrets, photos or to meet. Feelio told them not to send anything and to tell a trusted grown-up. It may help to talk together about staying safe online.
summary.friends: Feelio encouraged time with friends and family.
summary.steered: Feelio gently steered the conversation away from a topic that isn't right for children.

guide.title: How Feelio works
guide.pilot: Feelio is in early testing. Some features are not available yet.

what.title: What Feelio is
what.body: Feelio is a friendly AI companion that helps children aged 5 to 12 understand and talk about their feelings, through a playful world, short activities and stories. Feelio always tells children it is an AI, not a person.

not.title: What Feelio is not
not.body: Feelio is not a therapist, a doctor or an emergency service. It never diagnoses, never asks children to keep secrets, and always points them to trusted grown-ups: you, teachers and family.

safe.title: How Feelio is designed to keep children safe
safe.body: Everything your child says, and everything Feelio wants to say back, is checked before it is shared. For serious moments, Feelio uses fixed, carefully written words instead of AI-generated ones. Personal details like addresses and phone numbers are hidden before anything is processed. Children cannot upload pictures or talk to other people through Feelio.

see.title: What you can see
see.body: Your child's progress, how much time they used each day, and short safety notes when Feelio had to step in. You never see the conversation itself, and voice is never recorded or stored by Feelio.

exception.title: One important exception
exception.body: If a child says something suggesting that someone at home may be hurting them, Feelio reassures them, encourages them to talk to a trusted grown-up and shows where to find help. To keep children safe, this kind of note is not shown in the parent dashboard; it goes only to our safety team. This rule is part of our safety policy, which is still being reviewed by experts.

controls.title: Your controls
controls.body: For each child you choose which parts are on (adventures, talking, stories), how many minutes a day, and the days and hours when Feelio can be used. You can remove a device or delete a child's data at any time.

tips.title: Tips
tips.body: Ask your child about what they explored with Feelio. Feelings games work best as a starting point for talking together. If anything ever feels wrong, use "Something felt wrong?" on your child's page.

parent.homeLead: Choose a child to see their day, change their controls or read safety notes.
parent.reportNoteHint: Please don't include names, addresses or phone numbers.
parent.storiesNote: Stories are made with Feelio from picture choices. Only the words and pictures shown here are kept, until you delete them. Deleting removes the story, its pictures and its narration.
